item.title: Arachni Security Scanner Source Code Analysis (Part 1)
item.description: Arachni is a web security vulnerability scanner built on the Ruby on Rails framework. 1. Ruby on Rails Ruby on Rails, abbreviated ROR, is a web framework that consists of two parts: the Ruby language and the Rails framework. Ruby had always been popular in Japan, until 2004, when a 26-year-old Dane, David Heinemeier Hansson, proposed the web framework Rails.
